option_relations.rationale: Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis is a specific type of SARS-CoV-2 related arthritis, making it an equivalent diagnosis in this context.
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease, distinct from inflammatory arthritis related to viral infections.
Reactive arthritis (post-viral) is a broader category that includes SARS-CoV-2 related arthritis as a specific instance.
Post-COVID-19 syndrome with osteoarticular and neurological manifestations describes a broader set of symptoms and is not a specific diagnosis of arthritis related to SARS-CoV-2.
